radio: replace broken RadioSEGA FLAC stream

RadioSEGA's official FLAC mount now returns HTTP 503. Use its working Opus HQ mount at 128 kbps and retain explicit codec and playback coverage so another endpoint regression cannot silently ship.

Keep the curated ten-station FLAC invariant with the existing Sector Radio lossless stream.
